intro: Booking a room on HostelPalika holds one bed for you at a real hostel while you get there. This page is the whole process: what you pay, who decides what, and every deadline on the way.
How much money comes back if a booking ends early is set out in the refund policy.

body: You pay a booking fee to HostelPalika, not to the hostel, and we ask the hostel to hold one bed of that room type for you.
The fee is 7% of one month's rent for that room type. You see the exact amount in rupees before you pay anything.
It is not rent, admission fee or deposit. The hostel charges those in the ordinary way when you move in.
One booking at a time: finish or cancel the one you have before you start another.
sections.title: What a booking is

body: The hostel has to be live here, taking bookings, and have a free bed of the room type you want. If it does not, the Book button says so instead of taking your money.
You sign in with your own account and it needs an email address: the invoice, the receipt and every step below are emailed to you.
You give the eSewa, Khalti or bank account a refund should go to, and accept the refund policy.
Someone already living at a hostel cannot book a bed at that same hostel.
sections.title: Before you can book

body: Pick the room type and book. We raise your invoice straight away and email it to you.
Pay the fee to our collection QR and send the screenshot. A booking with no screenshot closes after 24 hours, and it owes nothing and holds nothing.
We check the screenshot within 24 hours and email you the receipt. If something is wrong with it we say why, and you can send another.
The hostel then has 24 hours to confirm or decline. We tell you either way.
Once it confirms, one bed is held for you for 7 days, counted in 24-hour blocks from that moment.
Move in inside that window. The hostel scans your HostelPalika ID card, the held bed becomes yours, and the booking is finished.
sections.title: Step by step

body: Send your screenshot within 24 hours of booking.
We answer it within 24 hours.
The hostel answers within 24 hours of our check. If it never answers, the booking ends and you get the whole fee back.
The bed is held for 7 days from the moment the hostel confirms, and we remind you 24 hours before the hold runs out.
If you have not moved in when the hold ends, the booking ends as a no-show and the bed goes back to the hostel.
sections.title: The deadlines

body: Cancel from My bookings whenever you like. The screen shows exactly what comes back before you press anything.
Cancel before the hostel confirms and the whole fee comes back.
After it confirms, what comes back depends on which day of the hold you cancel on. The refund policy lists every step.
Refunds go to the account you gave when you booked. We send them by hand and email you the amount and the transaction ID.
sections.title: Changing your mind

body: The Book button appears on your listing once bookings are switched on, your listing is live and the account we pay you into is verified. Add it under Bookings → Settings; we check it before any payout.
Every request waits for you under Bookings. You have 24 hours from our payment check to confirm or decline, and we remind you before it runs out.
Confirming holds one bed of that room type for 7 days. Admit the person the normal way, by scanning their ID card in Register a new resident, and the held bed becomes theirs.
Whatever is not refunded is shared: 60% to the hostel, the rest to HostelPalika. We send your share by hand and email a payout advice with the transaction ID.
Missing an answer, or cancelling a booking you had confirmed, counts as a missed booking. 3 of them inside 30 days pauses the Book button on your hostel until we turn it back on.
Declining a request in time costs you nothing.
sections.title: If you run a hostel

intro: This policy covers rooms booked on HostelPalika. A booking keeps the terms in force on the day it is made, and its invoice prints them.

body: The booking fee is 7% of one month's rent for the room type, shown before you book.
You pay it to HostelPalika, not to the hostel. It does not count towards rent, admission fee or deposit.
We check your payment screenshot within 24 hours. A booking with no screenshot closes after 24 hours and owes nothing.
sections.title: The booking fee

body: You cancel before the hostel confirms.
The hostel declines, or does not answer within 24 hours of our payment check.
The hostel cancels after confirming.
HostelPalika cancels the booking.
sections.title: Full refund

body: One bed is held for you for 7 days, counted in 24-hour blocks from the moment the hostel confirms.
Cancel on days 1–2 of the hold: 75% back.
Cancel on days 3–5 of the hold: 50% back.
Cancel on days 6–7 of the hold: 25% back.
Not moved in when the hold ends: 0% back.
When the hostel scans your ID card and admits you, the booking is complete and nothing is refunded.
sections.title: After the hostel confirms

body: A short stay is a few nights, paid upfront with the booking fee. The fee is charged once for every started week between booking and move-in.
Cancelled before the move-in day, declined, or not answered by the hostel: every night is refunded.
Cancelled on the move-in day, or not checked in by the end of the next day: one night is kept and the rest refunded.
Leaving before the move-out date: nights not stayed are not refunded.
sections.title: Short stays

body: Refunds go to the eSewa, Khalti or bank account you give when you book.
When we send a refund, we email you the amount and the transaction ID.
Whatever is not refunded is shared between the hostel and HostelPalika.
sections.title: How refunds are sent
